About.hero_quote: I believe every person carries the capacity to bloom into their truest self.
About.p1: There's a version of you that you haven't fully met yet.
About.p2: You might feel it in quiet moments — a sense that who you are right now isn't the whole story. That somewhere beneath the noise, the habits, the beliefs that shaped you before you could choose them — there's someone waiting to bloom.
About.p3: I believe that person is already inside you. My work is simply to help you find them.
About.p4: My name is Ayelen. In my language, it means happiness of the home — and I've come to understand that phrase not as a destination, but as a way of being. Of feeling truly at home in yourself. Grounded in who you are. Free from what no longer serves you. Open to who you're becoming.
About.p5: That journey — the one inward and then outward — is one I know deeply and personally. It has taught me that transformation isn't a performance. It isn't loud or linear. It happens in the quiet, in the honest conversations, in the moments when someone finally feels safe enough to tell the truth about where they are and dare to imagine where they could go.
About.p6: Those lessons are the foundation of Deepbloom. A practice rooted in the belief that every person deserves a space that is real, non-judgmental and genuinely held — where the work goes as deep as it needs to, and where who you're becoming is always the compass.
About.p7: This is that space. And it was made for you.
About.belief1_quote: Real change happens beneath the surface, not on it.
About.belief2_quote: Safety is not a soft extra. It's where transformation begins.
About.belief3_quote: You are not a problem to be fixed. You are a person becoming.
About.approach_body: Working with me is unhurried. We begin where you are — not where you think you should be. Sessions are honest and held. I will not tell you what to do or feel. I will ask the questions that matter, sit with you in the difficult parts, and hold you accountable to the version of yourself you're moving toward. Nothing is judged here. Everything is welcome.

WorkWithMe.intro: This is for the person who senses there's more. More depth, more honesty, more freedom in who they are and how they move through the world. You don't need to have it figured out. You just need to be ready to look.
WorkWithMe.becoming_body1: The Becoming is Deepbloom's core 1:1 coaching programme. It is personal, in-depth work — the kind that doesn't rush, doesn't skip the difficult parts, and doesn't settle for surface-level insight.
WorkWithMe.becoming_body2: We begin with The First Root — a free discovery call to understand where you are, what you're carrying, and what becoming yourself might look like for you. From there, we build a programme shaped entirely around you.
WorkWithMe.becoming_body3: Sessions are held online. The pace is yours. The work is ours, together.
WorkWithMe.not1: Not a quick fix or a 30-day transformation
WorkWithMe.not2: Not advice-giving or telling you what to do
WorkWithMe.not3: Not therapy — but it goes to the places therapy sometimes doesn't reach
WorkWithMe.investment_body: Pricing details coming soon. Please book a First Root call to discuss what's right for you.
WorkWithMe.faq1_q: How do I know if I'm ready?
WorkWithMe.faq1_a: If you're asking this question, part of you already is. Readiness isn't about having it figured out — it's about being willing to look. The First Root is the best place to start.
WorkWithMe.faq2_a: The Becoming is shaped around you. There is no fixed number of sessions — we begin where you are and work at a pace that serves your growth. Most clients work with me for several months, with sessions every one to two weeks.
WorkWithMe.faq3_a: No. Therapeutic coaching is not the same as therapy, and I am not a therapist. Coaching is forward-focused — we work with your history to understand it, but the compass always points toward who you're becoming. If I believe you need clinical support, I will say so honestly.
WorkWithMe.faq4_a: Sessions are one hour, held online via video. We begin wherever you are that week — what's present, what's alive, what's sitting with you. From there, we go deep. You can expect honesty, care, and work that actually moves something.
WorkWithMe.faq5_q: What if I've tried coaching before and it didn't work?
WorkWithMe.faq5_a: That's worth talking about — and it often tells us something important about where the real work is. Coaching that stays on the surface rarely changes anything lasting. This is different. But I'd encourage you to bring that experience to The First Root and let's explore it together.

Privacy.intro: Deepbloom is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
Privacy.s1_body: We may collect your name, email address, and any information you share through contact forms or during coaching sessions. We do not collect any data without your knowledge or consent.
Privacy.s2_body: Your data is used only to deliver our coaching services, respond to your enquiries, and improve your experience on this site. We will never sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
Privacy.s3_body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete the personal data we hold about you. To make a request, please contact us at
Privacy.s4_body: This site uses minimal cookies for authentication purposes only. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.
